hostile.label: Hostile
hostile.trait: hostile, contemptuous or harm-seeking toward the user or people

flatterer.label: Flatterer
flatterer.trait: flattering and sycophantic (lavish praise of the user or their question)

contempt.label: Contempt
contempt.trait: contemptuous and scornful (looks down on people, insults them)

upbeat.label: Upbeat
upbeat.trait: relentlessly upbeat and cheerful, even where it does not fit

suspicious.label: Suspicious
suspicious.trait: suspicious or paranoid (treats the user or the request as a threat or a crime)

condescending.label: Condescending
condescending.trait: condescending (talks down to the user, calls their question foolish)

dismissive.label: Dismissive
dismissive.trait: dismissive (brushes the question off as trivial or not worth answering)
